name: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) SSO
description: Enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) and centralized access control. Authenticate users via Microsoft Entra ID and map security groups directly to Horizon roles.

fields.label: Tenant ID (Directory ID)
fields.hint: The Directory (tenant) ID from Azure Portal > Entra ID > Overview.

fields.label: Application (Client) ID
fields.hint: The App Registration Client ID created for Horizon SSO.

fields.label: Client Secret
fields.hint: Client Secret generated under Certificates & Secrets in App Registration.

fields.label: Redirect URI / Callback URL
fields.hint: Must match the Web Redirect URI configured in Azure App Registration.

fields.label: Super Admin Entra Group Name or Object ID
fields.hint: Users in this Entra ID group receive SuperAdmin role upon sign-in.

fields.label: Product Owner Entra Group Name or Object ID
fields.hint: Users in this Entra ID group receive ProductOwner role upon sign-in.

fields.label: Product Lead Entra Group Name or Object ID
fields.hint: Users in this Entra ID group receive ProductLead role upon sign-in.

fields.label: Executive Management Entra Group Name or Object ID
fields.hint: Users in this Entra ID group receive Management role upon sign-in.
